physical_evidence: physical-35-ram-handles-and-cleanup: filesa,b created by our test; b renamed toc; c and a subsequently unlinked successfully; owned map,FDs,and directory handle all closed.
physical-35 command27: ustd.rmdir returned-1 without errno.

generic_and_native_paths.proof: A046C1EC finds the mounted backend and dispatches its+0x40 rmdir slot. RAM mount initialization A03528AA installs A03527A3 at that slot and registers /ram with strip-prefix flag1. A046AD04 strips /ram; A03527A2 acquires the RAM lock then calls A0353DC6(path,0). Native command A0357108 invokes that same core directly, without generic path translation. Native flags0 retains empty/protection checks.
generic_and_native_paths.native_output_advantage: Native command prints errno, unlike the generic ustd wrapper.

errno_map.16: Directory protection/state bytes+0x6E or+0x6F are nonzero.
errno_map.158: Directory child-directory count at+0x68 or child-file count+0x6A is nonzero.

likely_cause.status: static inference pending native errno confirmation
likely_cause.description: Rename to a new filename increments the destination parent file counter while allocating the placeholder, then increments it again after copying the source entry. For a rename within one directory the later decrement and increment cancel, leaving the placeholder increment as a phantom file count. After deleting the real files, listing can be empty while rmdir sees a nonzero count.
proof: A03557EE rename file path callsA0354434(destination,0x8000) atA03558A2 thenA035471A toclose placeholder.
Rename copies the source entry to destination atA0355918 and clears source entry atA035594A..5954.
Rename decrements source parent+0x6A atA035595A..595E and increments destination parent+0x6A atA035596C..5970.
Unlink A0354824 decrements parent+0x6A once atA03548DA..48E0.
RmdirA0353DC6 rejects any nonzero+0x6A with errno158 atA0353E14..3E24.

preconditions: Native flag0 confirms errno158, consistent with phantom child count.
Actual owned directory listing remains empty.
All owned file descriptors, mapping and directory handle are closed, as physical35 recorded.
Exact path remains the agent-created test directory; do not generalize flag1 to another path.
conditional_owned_cleanup.effects: A0353DF6..3E08 zeroes only the target directory's two child counters and two protection bytes. The existing removal path then clears its parent entry, frees its own directory metadata blocks using its recorded block count, invalidates its path-cache entry and decrements its parent's directory counter. It does not traverse or recursively delete child files; empty-directory precondition is mandatory.
conditional_owned_cleanup.verify: udws "ustd.ls /ram;" must no longer contain codex_uart_20261029a.

ram_ls_classification_correction.name: ram.ls
ram_ls_classification_correction.old_description_issue: A passive listing/read-only classification is inaccurate.
ram_ls_classification_correction.control_flow: A0356A04 opens a generic directory descriptor, then A0356BAC calls A046BBEA(fd,24,-1,filter), closes descriptor, and prints DIR ... flush result. RAM ioctl24 atA03556F6 invokes A0355112.
actual_effects: Walks directory entry blocks, prints live FILE and <DIR> entries.
For type3 deleted-file/TRASH records it invokes block ownership/cache helpersA0355B18 andA0355C04.
If a trash record cannot be recovered, A03551B2..51D0 clears its type,blockID,size,name fields. The routine can therefore reclaim obsolete directory records and alter block metadata.
Default filter affects formatted output, not whether trash processing occurs.
ram_ls_classification_correction.historical_capture_note: Keep original raw capture and original plan hash intact; index this correction rather than rewriting historical evidence.
ram_ls_classification_correction.safer_passive_listing: Use ustd.ls /ram or ustd.ll /ram/codex_uart_20261029a when only enumeration is intended.
